test_title: PYST 12: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 12 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following pairs of neighbouring countries are landlocked and share only land borders with India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Nepal and Bhutan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nepal** and **Bhutan** are the two neighbouring countries of India that are completely **landlocked.**
 
• Being landlocked means these countries have no access to the **sea or ocean.**
 
• Both Nepal and Bhutan share **only land borders** with India and do not have any coastline or maritime boundary.
 
• **Nepal** is bordered by India on three sides (east, south, and west) and by **China** in the north.
 
• **Bhutan** shares its borders with India in the south, east, and west, while it is bordered by **China** in the north.
 
• These two countries are situated in the **Himalayan region** and are known for their mountainous terrain.
 
• Nepal is famous for housing the **world’s highest peak, Mount Everest**, while Bhutan is known for its **Gross National Happiness Index**.
 
• Both countries maintain **strong historical, cultural, and economic ties** with India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bangladesh and Myanmar**__

 __
 
• **Bangladesh** is not landlocked as it has access to the **Bay of Bengal**.
 
• **Myanmar** also has access to the **Bay of Bengal** and is not landlocked.
 
• These two countries share both **land and maritime borders** with India.
 
 
 
• **Pakistan and China**__
 __
 
• **Pakistan** is not landlocked as it has access to the **Arabian Sea**.
 
• **China** is also not landlocked as it has access to the **East China Sea, South China Sea, and Yellow Sea.**
 
• While these countries share land borders with India, they are not entirely landlocked.
 
 
 
• **Sri Lanka and Maldives**__
 
 
• **Sri Lanka** is an island nation located in the **Indian Ocean** and does not share land borders with India.
 
• **Maldives** is a group of islands in the **Indian Ocean** and also does not have land borders with India.
 
• Both countries are surrounded by water and are not landlocked.
